welcome.title: [Welcome to AIS Alumni]
welcome.about: This account is run by the AIS Alumni Committee, a volunteer group of AIS graduates. It is not an official account of Aichi International School.
welcome.receiveItems:
・News from the committee
・Mentions in chats
(Other notifications come by email. Use “Unread chats” and “News list” in the menu below to check chats and news any time.)
welcome.linked: ✅ Linked to your AIS Alumni account. News and mentions will arrive here on LINE.
welcome.notLinkedTitle: ■ Not linked to the app yet
welcome.notLinked:
To get notifications here, link LINE in the app:
1. Tap “Open app” below and sign in (new here? you can sign up right away)
2. Go to Settings → LINE → “Link LINE”
3. Sign in with LINE and allow access — that's it
welcome.settings: Choose LINE or email for news and mentions in the app under Settings → Notifications. If you block this account, we'll email you instead.
welcome.privacy:
We only store your LINE user ID and display name, and never read your chats. See the privacy policy for details:
{url}
welcome.buttonsText: See the directory, events and news in the app.

admin.title: LINE menu
admin.intro: Shows buttons (a rich menu) under the Official Account's chat instead of the keyboard. The top two, “Unread chats” and “News list”, get a reply in the chat (not counted toward LINE's message allowance); the rest open pages of the app.
admin.how: Creates a Japanese and an English menu; Japanese is the default and members who use English get the English one. Members with unread chats or news see a red dot on those buttons (updated every minute). Press “Update” after changing labels or pages (old menus are deleted).
admin.done: Menu installed ({linked} members got the menu for their language and unread items; {removed} old menus deleted).

errors.notConfigured: LINE Messaging API credentials are not set.
errors.failed: Couldn't install the menu on LINE.

admin.installConfirm: This changes the menu for every LINE friend. Continue?

usage.title: LINE messages this month
usage.nearLimit: This month's limit is close. Anything over it can't go by LINE and is sent by email instead.
usage.unavailable: Couldn't get the count from LINE (the Messaging API isn't set up, or a temporary error).
usage.byCategory: Sent by this app, by kind ({count})
usage.none: Nothing sent by LINE yet this month.
usage.hint: LINE counts each message once per person who receives it. Replies aren't counted. The count resets on the 1st of each month (Japan time).
